name: Jasmine Boreal
description: A legendary human druid who briefly joined the Robaran Circle of Seven.

timeline.summary: In 3334 AR Adira's party arrives at Buzzard's Bay in search of Johan.
timeline.quote: arrived at Buzzard's Bay in search of Johan

timeline.summary: A tavern brawl erupts and Jasmine Boreal casts Fog so Adira and her Circle can flee.
timeline.quote: until Jasmine Boreal cast a Fog spell, allowing Adira and her Circle to flee the scene

timeline.summary: A party of Jedit, Adira, Jasmine and the Circle of Seven frees the Cosmic Horror, which summons a Falling Star to annihilate the caverns; Shauku secretly escapes.

timeline.summary: Jasmine and Heath become lovers during their ship voyage in Buzzard's Bay.

timeline.summary: Jasmine recounts the history of the pinefolks to the Seveners upon reaching Arboria.

timeline.summary: Jasmine casts Earthquake in the dungeons of Shauku's castle, disabling the vampire so the Robarans escape.
timeline.quote: which temporarily disabled the vampire , permitting the Robarans' escape

timeline.summary: Jasmine quits the Robarans to remain with the pinefolk of Arboria and learn from their shaman.
